selected.description: Malaysian singer-songwriter known for her soulful voice and blend of pop, R&B, and folk music.

properties.description: BANKS (Jillian Rose Banks) is an American singer-songwriter who blends moody electropop with alternative R&B and downtempo electronic production. She emerged internationally after two 2013 EPs (Fall Over, London) and received critical acclaim for her debut album Goddess (2014), which spawned the platinum single "Beggin for Thread." Subsequent albums The Altar (2016) and III (2019) reinforced her reputation for intimate, atmospheric production, confessional lyrics, and a dark, minimalist aesthetic.

Rinni Wulandari is an Indonesian singer who gained fame after winning the fourth season of Indonesian Idol. She is recognized for her powerful vocal ability and soulful style, blending pop, soul, and R&B influences in her music. Rinni has released several albums and singles, establishing herself as a prominent figure in the Indonesian music scene.

Teza Sumendra is an Indonesian singer-songwriter and musician recognized for his soulful voice and heartfelt pop and acoustic songs. He has gained popularity in Indonesia's music scene with his melodic tunes and introspective lyrics.

Birdy, born Jasmine Lucilla Elizabeth Jennifer van den Bogaerde, is an English singer, songwriter, and musician who gained fame as a teenager with her cover of Bon Iver's 'Skinny Love.' She is known for her emotive, delicate voice and her blend of indie pop and folk music. Birdy's music often features piano-driven melodies and introspective lyrics, and she has released several albums showcasing her growth as an artist.

Daniela Andrade is a Canadian singer-songwriter and musician recognized for her gentle, acoustic-driven indie pop and folk music. She gained popularity through her YouTube channel where she posts covers and original songs, characterized by her intimate vocal style and minimalist arrangements. Her music often features themes of love, introspection, and personal growth, delivered with a soothing and emotive voice.

Honne is a British electronic music duo formed by James Hatcher and Andy Clutterbuck. They are known for blending electronic music with soul and R&B influences, creating a smooth, synth-driven sound characterized by warm vocals and lush production. Their music often features themes of love, relationships, and emotional vulnerability, delivered with a modern yet nostalgic feel. Honne has gained a dedicated following for their emotive songwriting and polished electronic arrangements.

Rendy Pandugo is an Indonesian singer-songwriter and musician recognized for his smooth blend of indie pop, acoustic, and soul music. He gained popularity through his heartfelt lyrics and mellow vocal style, often accompanied by acoustic guitar. His music often features a relaxed, intimate vibe with influences from R&B and folk genres.

Johnny Stimson is an American singer-songwriter and musician known for his soulful voice and blend of pop, R&B, and indie influences. He has gained recognition for his emotive songwriting and smooth vocal delivery, often incorporating elements of blue-eyed soul and indie pop into his music.

Ellie Goulding is an English singer-songwriter who rose to prominence in the early 2010s with a signature breathy soprano, blending folky songwriting with synth-driven electronic pop. Her debut album 'Lights' (2010) and follow-ups 'Halcyon' (2012) and 'Delirium' (2015) produced international hits including 'Lights', 'Starry Eyed', 'Burn' and 'Love Me Like You Do' (a global smash from the Fifty Shades of Grey soundtrack). She has collaborated with prominent producers and artists across pop and EDM, won critical awards early in her career, and built a global fanbase through chart success, festival appearances and high-profile collaborations. She is also known for charitable and environmental advocacy and was appointed MBE in 2023.

Eva Celia Lesmana, known professionally as Eva Celia, is an Indonesian singer, songwriter, and actress. She is recognized for her smooth jazz and pop vocal style, blending soulful and R&B influences in her music. Eva is also known for her acting career in Indonesian cinema and television.

Banda Neira is an Indonesian indie folk band formed in 2010, consisting of members Ananda Badudu, Rara Sekar, and Ade Paloh. They are recognized for their poetic and introspective lyrics combined with gentle acoustic instrumentation, creating a distinctive indie folk and indie pop sound. Their music often explores themes of love, social issues, and personal reflection, resonating deeply with a young Indonesian audience. Banda Neira has played a significant role in the Indonesian indie music scene, influencing many contemporary artists.

Jeremy Passion is an American singer-songwriter and musician known for his soulful acoustic R&B style. He gained popularity through YouTube by posting covers and original songs, blending smooth vocals with heartfelt lyrics and acoustic guitar arrangements. His music often features themes of love, relationships, and personal growth, delivered with a warm and intimate vocal style.

Kimbra Lee Johnson, known mononymously as Kimbra, is a New Zealand singer and songwriter who gained international recognition for her unique blend of indie pop, alternative R&B, and art pop. She is noted for her eclectic musical style that incorporates elements of jazz, funk, and electronic music, as well as her distinctive vocal techniques and layered harmonies. Kimbra first rose to prominence with her collaboration on Gotye's hit single "Somebody That I Used to Know," which won multiple awards and brought her global attention. Her solo work is characterized by experimental production, complex rhythms, and introspective lyrics.

Raisa Andriana, known mononymously as Raisa, is an Indonesian singer and songwriter famous for her soulful voice and pop music style. She has gained widespread popularity in Indonesia and Southeast Asia with her emotive vocal delivery and contemporary pop and R&B sound.

Jeff Bernat is a Filipino-American singer-songwriter and producer who gained recognition for his smooth, soulful voice and laid-back R&B style. He blends elements of soul, pop, and jazz to create a mellow and intimate sound. Bernat's music often features acoustic instrumentation and heartfelt lyrics, appealing to fans of contemporary R&B and neo soul. He has built a dedicated fanbase through his independent releases and has been praised for his vocal delivery and songwriting skills.
